_comment: Schema reference for processed_requests/{requestId}. Existing Phase 3 webhook receipts remain compatible; Phase 4 client mutation receipts require the actor/input/result binding fields below.
_spec_ref: docs/phase4_decisions.md P4-D012, P4-D013, P4-D015, P4-D016 and §processed_requests/{id} additions
_phase4_invariant: For accept, decline, driver_cancel, start_job, and complete_job, the document ID is the client requestId and must bind actorUid, operation, resourceId, payloadHash, and stored result. Reuse with any different binding fails closed. Domain/financial completion and the completed receipt are committed in the same transaction.

type.description: Legacy/general request category, including whatsapp_message, razorpay_webhook, and phase4_client_mutation.

actorUid.description: Required non-null and equal to request.auth.uid for every Phase 4 authenticated client mutation.

resourceId.description: Required non-null canonical immutable input identity binding the job and, when applicable, offer (for example jobId/offerId).

payloadHash.description: Required non-null hash of the canonical immutable input. Different input under a reused requestId fails closed.

result.description: Stable stored result returned for a binding-identical retry.
